yearValidityFlag.finding: CONFIRMED YEAR MISMATCH, and severe. This document is titled 'SPECIAL NON-RESIDENTS RATES 2025' and its own five season windows cover: 3 Jan-22 Apr 2025 & 1 Jul-31 Aug 2025; 23 Apr-30 Jun 2025; 1 Sep-31 Oct 2025; 1 Nov-22 Dec 2025; and 23 Dec 2025-2 Jan 2026. That means ONLY 1-2 January 2026 is actually covered by this rate card. Every other date in 2026 (3 Jan 2026 onward) has NO published rate in this document at all, despite it living inside the '2026 CONTRACT RATES' folder tree. This mirrors the Pristine Mara Bay Lodge finding in this same batch — flag prominently on any 2026 quote beyond 2 January; a current 2026 rate card would need to be requested from the hotel or Sunworld before quoting any other 2026 date.

extractionMethod.note: Read directly via pdftotext -layout across both pages.

structuralFindings: Rates are per ROOM (Single/Double), with separate flat add-on lines for 3rd Bed, Child under 12, and Infant under 2 — a hybrid per-room-plus-occupant-addon structure.
Four meal plans priced in parallel for every season: Bed & Breakfast, Half Board, Full Board, All Inclusive — a fuller meal-plan ladder than most properties in this batch.

Five pricing seasons across the (2025-into-2026) year, with a sharply escalated Festive window (23 Dec-2 Jan) roughly double the standard rate — e.g. Single B&B jumps from $226 (Nov-Dec) to $453 (Festive).

Room-category supplements exist SEPARATELY from the base Single/Double table: Seaview/Superior +$60/room/day, Deluxe +$55/room/day, and a Suite at a flat $726/day (or $1,500/day specifically during Festive season) — these aren't folded into the main table at all.

Child policy stated in TWO different places with seemingly different numbers: the main rate table has a flat 'CHILD UNDER 12YRS' dollar figure per season/meal-plan; a separate 'CHILD POLICIES' footnote instead says 'Rooms 6-12 Years in own room is 80% of adult room rate' — these are not obviously reconcilable (a flat $ figure vs an 80% ratio) and appear to be two different children's provisions (a child SHARING with parents at the flat table rate, vs a child in their OWN separate room at 80% of adult rate) rather than a contradiction — but this interpretation is not stated explicitly in the source, so flagged as [Inference].
Day Room charge is 75% of room rate up to 18:00; full rate applies automatically thereafter.
Rates stated as inclusive of all taxes and service charge.
